species-richness-all-hex.title: MOBI Species Richness — H3 Hex Parquet (resolution 8, exact-extract max)

table:columns.name: species_richness
table:columns.description: Maximum modeled species richness (count of species with predicted suitable habitat) among source-raster pixels covering this cell, via area-weighted exact-extract with the `max` reducer. One row per cell — query directly, no GROUP BY needed. Integer-valued, range 0–32. To view at a coarser resolution, GROUP BY h7 (or h6/h5) and take MAX(species_richness) — MAX-of-MAX preserves the hotspot; never AVG/SUM across the rollup.

table:columns.name: h8
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 8 (native resolution; one row per h8 cell).

table:columns.name: h7
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 7 (parent of h8; rollup key).

table:columns.name: h6
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 6 (rollup key).

table:columns.name: h5
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 5 (rollup key).

table:columns.name: h0
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 0, used as the Hive partition key.

v2-irrecoverable-2024-hex.title: v2: Irrecoverable Carbon 2024 - H3 Hexagonal Tiling (res 9)
v2-irrecoverable-2024-hex.description: Total carbon (Mg C) at H3 resolution 9, area-corrected from the ~300 m Mg C/ha source density (density × pixel ground area, area-weighted via exact_extract; one row per h9 cell). SUM(carbon) is directly valid as a total — no GROUP BY/dedup. Validated global SUM ≈ 131.9 Gt C. Hive-partitioned by h0.

table:columns.name: carbon
table:columns.description: Total carbon stock in this H3 cell, in Mg C (megagrams = tonnes). Computed as source carbon density (Mg C ha⁻¹) × cell ground area, area-weighted via exact_extract from the ~300 m source. ONE row per h9 cell — SAFE to SUM(carbon) directly across rows (no GROUP BY, no dedup; raster hex). Global SUM reproduces the published carbon total.

links.title: Detailed Data Documentation and Usage Examples

combined-parquet.title: GeoParquet file with all 656,986 protected areas
combined-parquet.description: Cloud-native GeoParquet format optimized for analytical queries. Use with DuckDB, Polars, pandas, or any GeoParquet-compatible tool. Geometries in EPSG:4326.

table:columns.name: _cng_fid
table:columns.description: Cloud-native geometry feature ID. Unique identifier for each protected area feature. Use this for joining between GeoParquet and H3 hex formats.

table:columns.name: FeatClass
table:columns.description: Feature class indicating the type of protection: 'Fee' (owned), 'Easement' (conservation easement), 'Designation' (administrative boundary), 'Marine' (marine protected area), or 'Proclamation' (authorized boundary). Values: Designation=Designation (management overlay on other lands), Easement=Easement interest, Fee=Fee simple ownership interest, Marine=Marine protected area, Proclamation=Approved, proclamation or extent boundary

table:columns.name: Category
table:columns.description: Protection type category indicating which PAD-US layer the feature comes from. Values: Designation=Designation (management overlay on other lands), Easement=Easement interest, Fee=Fee simple ownership interest, Marine=Marine protected area, Other=Other protection mechanism, Proclamation=Approved, proclamation or extent boundary, Unknown=Unknown protection mechanism

table:columns.name: Own_Type
table:columns.description: Owner type code. Values: DESG=Designation, DIST=Regional agency / special district, FED=Federal, JNT=Joint (multiple owners/managers), LOC=Local government, NGO=Non-governmental organization, PVT=Private, STAT=State, TERR=Territorial, TRIB=American Indian / Tribal lands, UNK=Unknown

table:columns.name: Own_Name
table:columns.description: Owner name. Specific agency, organization, or entity that holds legal title to the protected area. Examples: 'Department of Defense', 'The Nature Conservancy', 'California State Parks'.

table:columns.name: Loc_Own
table:columns.description: Local owner name. Owner name in local terminology or original language when different from Own_Name. May be null if same as Own_Name.

table:columns.name: Mang_Type
table:columns.description: Manager type code. Same code set as Own_Type. Values: DIST=Regional agency / special district, FED=Federal, JNT=Joint (multiple owners/managers), LOC=Local government, NGO=Non-governmental organization, PVT=Private, STAT=State, TERR=Territorial, TRIB=American Indian / Tribal lands, UNK=Unknown

table:columns.name: Mang_Name
table:columns.description: Manager name. Agency or organization responsible for day-to-day management and operations. Examples: 'National Park Service', 'U.S. Forest Service', 'State Wildlife Agency'. May differ from Owner.

table:columns.name: Loc_Mang
table:columns.description: Local manager name. Manager name in local terminology when different from Mang_Name. May be null if same as Mang_Name.

table:columns.name: Des_Tp
table:columns.description: Designation type code. Standardized code for the type of designation (e.g., 'NP' for National Park, 'NWR' for National Wildlife Refuge, 'WILD' for Wilderness). See PAD-US Designation_Type lookup table for complete list. Values: ACC=Access Area, ACEC=Area of Critical Environmental Concern, AGRE=Agricultural Easement, CONE=Conservation Easement, FORE=Forest Stewardship Easement, FOTH=Federal Other or Unknown, HCA=Historic or Cultural Area, HCAE=Historic or Cultural Easement, IRA=Inventoried Roadless Area, LCA=Local Conservation Area, LHCA=Local Historic or Cultural Area, LOTH=Local Other or Unknown, LP=Local Park, LREC=Local Recreation Area, LRMA=Local Resource Management Area, MIL=Military Land, MIT=Mitigation Land or Bank, MPA=Marine Protected Area, NCA=Conservation Area, ND=Not Designated, NF=National Forest, NG=National Grassland, NLS=National Lakeshore or Seashore, NM=National Monument, NP=National Park, NRA=National Recreation Area, NSBV=National Scenic, Botanical or Volcanic Area, NT=National Scenic or Historic Trail, NWR=National Wildlife Refuge, OCS=Outer Continental Shelf Area, OTHE=Other Easement, PAGR=Private Agricultural, PCON=Private Conservation, PFOR=Private Forest Stewardship, PHCA=Private Historic or Cultural, POTH=Private Other or Unknown, PPRK=Private Park, PRAN=Private Ranch, PREC=Private Recreation or Education, PROC=Approved or Proclamation Boundary, PUB=National Public Lands, RANE=Ranch Easement, REA=Research or Educational Area, REC=Recreation Management Area, RECE=Recreation or Education Easement, RMA=Resource Management Area, RNA=Research Natural Area, SCA=State Conservation Area, SDA=Special Designation Area, SHCA=State Historic or Cultural Area, SOTH=State Other or Unknown, SP=State Park, SREC=State Recreation Area, SRMA=State Resource Management Area, SW=State Wilderness, TRIBL=Native American Land Area, UNK=Unknown, UNKE=Unknown Easement, WA=Wilderness Area, WPA=Watershed Protection Area, WSA=Wilderness Study Area, WSR=Wild and Scenic River

table:columns.name: Loc_Ds
table:columns.description: Local designation. Official designation name in original language or local terminology. Examples: 'Parque Nacional', 'Área Natural Protegida'.

table:columns.name: Unit_Nm
table:columns.description: Unit name. Official name of the protected area as designated by the managing authority. Primary identifier for the site.

table:columns.name: Loc_Nm
table:columns.description: Local name. Alternative, historical, or local name for the protected area when different from Unit_Nm. May be null if no alternative name exists.

table:columns.name: State_Nm
table:columns.description: State name. U.S. state, territory, or freely associated state where the protected area is located. Two-letter postal abbreviations (e.g., 'CA', 'PR', 'GU'). Values: AK=Alaska, AL=Alabama, AR=Arkansas, AS=American Samoa, AZ=Arizona, CA=California, CO=Colorado, CT=Connecticut, DC=District of Columbia, DE=Delaware, FL=Florida, GA=Georgia, GU=Guam, HI=Hawaii, IA=Iowa, ID=Idaho, IL=Illinois, IN=Indiana, KS=Kansas, KY=Kentucky, LA=Louisiana, MA=Massachusetts, MD=Maryland, ME=Maine, MI=Michigan, MN=Minnesota, MO=Missouri, MP=Northern Mariana Islands, MS=Mississippi, MT=Montana, NC=North Carolina, ND=North Dakota, NE=Nebraska, NH=New Hampshire, NJ=New Jersey, NM=New Mexico, NV=Nevada, NY=New York, OH=Ohio, OK=Oklahoma, OR=Oregon, PA=Pennsylvania, PR=Puerto Rico, RI=Rhode Island, SC=South Carolina, SD=South Dakota, TN=Tennessee, TX=Texas, UM=U.S. Minor Outlying Islands, UNKF=Unknown (state/territory not determined), UT=Utah, VA=Virginia, VI=U.S. Virgin Islands, VT=Vermont, WA=Washington, WI=Wisconsin, WV=West Virginia, WY=Wyoming

table:columns.name: Agg_Src
table:columns.description: Aggregator source. Organization that compiled or aggregated the data, often state agencies or regional coordination entities that collected source data into PAD-US.

table:columns.name: GIS_Src
table:columns.description: GIS source. Original GIS data provider or source dataset name. Indicates where the spatial data came from (e.g., agency name, dataset title).

table:columns.name: Src_Date
table:columns.description: Source date. Date of the source GIS data in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format. Indicates when the source spatial data was created or last updated by the providing agency.

table:columns.name: GIS_Acres
table:columns.description: GIS-calculated area in acres of the source polygon. Most reliable area measure, calculated from the geometry.

table:columns.name: Source_PAID
table:columns.description: Source Protected Area ID. Unique identifier from the source agency's dataset. Used to track provenance and updates from source systems.

table:columns.name: WDPA_Cd
table:columns.description: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) site code. Assigned to sites that are internationally recognized and included in the WDPA. Null for sites not in WDPA.

table:columns.name: Pub_Access
table:columns.description: Public access code. Values: OA=Open Access, RA=Restricted Access, UK=Unknown, XA=Closed Access

table:columns.name: Access_Src
table:columns.description: Access source. Source of the public access information (e.g., agency website, management plan, direct contact with manager).

table:columns.name: Access_Dt
table:columns.description: Access date. Date the public access status was determined or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: GAP_Sts
table:columns.description: GAP Status Code indicating level of biodiversity management protection. Values: 1=Permanent protection, biodiversity the primary management goal; natural disturbance proceeds or is mimicked, 2=Permanent protection, biodiversity the primary management goal; natural disturbance suppressed, 3=Permanent protection, managed for multiple uses subject to extractive (e.g. mining, logging) or OHV use, 4=No known mandate for biodiversity protection

table:columns.name: GAPCdSrc
table:columns.description: GAP Code source. Source document or authority used to assign the GAP Status Code (e.g., enabling legislation, management plan, agency policy).

table:columns.name: GAPCdDt
table:columns.description: GAP Code date. Date the GAP Status Code was assigned or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: IUCN_Cat
table:columns.description: IUCN Protected Area Management Category. Values: II=National Park, III=Natural Monument or Feature, IV=Habitat/Species Management Area, Ia=Strict Nature Reserve, Ib=Wilderness Area, Other Conservation Area=Other conservation area (does not meet IUCN protected-area definition), Unassigned=Not assigned an IUCN management category, V=Protected Landscape/Seascape, VI=Protected area with sustainable use of natural resources

table:columns.name: IUCNCtSrc
table:columns.description: IUCN Category source. Source document or authority used to assign the IUCN Category (e.g., management objectives, legislation).

table:columns.name: IUCNCtDt
table:columns.description: IUCN Category date. Date the IUCN Category was assigned or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: Date_Est
table:columns.description: Date established. When the protected area protection was formally established (legislation signed, easement recorded, etc.). Format varies: YYYYMMDD, YYYY, or text description for historical areas.

table:columns.name: Comments
table:columns.description: Comments. Additional information, caveats, special notes, or clarifications about the protected area feature. May include data quality notes, boundary uncertainties, or historical context.

table:columns.name: Term
table:columns.description: Term flag. Indicates temporary protection: 1 = temporary or term-limited protection; 0 or NULL = permanent protection. Used to identify conservation easements or agreements with expiration dates.

table:columns.name: Duration
table:columns.description: Duration. Description of protection duration for term-limited protections (e.g., '20 years', 'until 2050', 'renewable 10-year terms'). Null for permanent protections.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Shape length. Perimeter length in meters calculated in the original coordinate reference system (USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic). For reference only - recalculate in appropriate CRS for analysis.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Shape area. Area in square meters calculated in the original coordinate reference system (USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic). For reference only - use GIS_Acres for area comparisons.

table:columns.name: SHAPE
table:columns.description: Geometry. Well-Known Binary (WKB) representation of the protected area boundary in EPSG:4326 (WGS84). Typically MULTIPOLYGON geometry type. Use for spatial operations and mapping.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box. Minimum bounding rectangle of the geometry with coordinates in EPSG:4326. Useful for spatial indexing and quick extent checks without processing full geometry.

combined-hex.title: H3 hex-indexed parquet files
combined-hex.description: Parquet files partitioned by H3 cell at resolution 10 (15m²) and resolution 8 (0.74 km²) for 20 complex features. Partitioned by h0 for efficient spatial queries. Each row contains a protected area feature with its intersecting H3 cell. Per-feature attribute columns (GIS_Acres) are repeated on every hex cell the feature covers, so a raw SUM over hex rows double-counts; dedup by _cng_fid first, e.g. SELECT DISTINCT _cng_fid, GIS_Acres. 138,834 of 656,986 source features are smaller than one native H3 cell and polyfill to zero cells, so they are absent from the hex; query the flat GeoParquet for complete feature coverage.

table:columns.name: _cng_fid
table:columns.description: Cloud-native geometry feature ID. Unique identifier for each protected area feature. Use this for joining between GeoParquet and H3 hex formats.

table:columns.name: FeatClass
table:columns.description: Feature class indicating the type of protection: 'Fee' (owned), 'Easement' (conservation easement), 'Designation' (administrative boundary), 'Marine' (marine protected area), or 'Proclamation' (authorized boundary). Values: Designation=Designation (management overlay on other lands), Easement=Easement interest, Fee=Fee simple ownership interest, Marine=Marine protected area, Proclamation=Approved, proclamation or extent boundary

table:columns.name: Category
table:columns.description: Protection type category indicating which PAD-US layer the feature comes from. Values: Designation=Designation (management overlay on other lands), Easement=Easement interest, Fee=Fee simple ownership interest, Marine=Marine protected area, Other=Other protection mechanism, Proclamation=Approved, proclamation or extent boundary, Unknown=Unknown protection mechanism

table:columns.name: Own_Type
table:columns.description: Owner type code. Values: DESG=Designation, DIST=Regional agency / special district, FED=Federal, JNT=Joint (multiple owners/managers), LOC=Local government, NGO=Non-governmental organization, PVT=Private, STAT=State, TERR=Territorial, TRIB=American Indian / Tribal lands, UNK=Unknown

table:columns.name: Own_Name
table:columns.description: Owner name. Specific agency, organization, or entity that holds legal title to the protected area. Examples: 'Department of Defense', 'The Nature Conservancy', 'California State Parks'.

table:columns.name: Loc_Own
table:columns.description: Local owner name. Owner name in local terminology or original language when different from Own_Name. May be null if same as Own_Name.

table:columns.name: Mang_Type
table:columns.description: Manager type code. Same code set as Own_Type. Values: DIST=Regional agency / special district, FED=Federal, JNT=Joint (multiple owners/managers), LOC=Local government, NGO=Non-governmental organization, PVT=Private, STAT=State, TERR=Territorial, TRIB=American Indian / Tribal lands, UNK=Unknown

table:columns.name: Mang_Name
table:columns.description: Manager name. Agency or organization responsible for day-to-day management and operations. Examples: 'National Park Service', 'U.S. Forest Service', 'State Wildlife Agency'. May differ from Owner.

table:columns.name: Loc_Mang
table:columns.description: Local manager name. Manager name in local terminology when different from Mang_Name. May be null if same as Mang_Name.

table:columns.name: Des_Tp
table:columns.description: Designation type code. Standardized code for the type of designation (e.g., 'NP' for National Park, 'NWR' for National Wildlife Refuge, 'WILD' for Wilderness). See PAD-US Designation_Type lookup table for complete list. Values: ACC=Access Area, ACEC=Area of Critical Environmental Concern, AGRE=Agricultural Easement, CONE=Conservation Easement, FORE=Forest Stewardship Easement, FOTH=Federal Other or Unknown, HCA=Historic or Cultural Area, HCAE=Historic or Cultural Easement, IRA=Inventoried Roadless Area, LCA=Local Conservation Area, LHCA=Local Historic or Cultural Area, LOTH=Local Other or Unknown, LP=Local Park, LREC=Local Recreation Area, LRMA=Local Resource Management Area, MIL=Military Land, MIT=Mitigation Land or Bank, MPA=Marine Protected Area, NCA=Conservation Area, ND=Not Designated, NF=National Forest, NG=National Grassland, NLS=National Lakeshore or Seashore, NM=National Monument, NP=National Park, NRA=National Recreation Area, NSBV=National Scenic, Botanical or Volcanic Area, NT=National Scenic or Historic Trail, NWR=National Wildlife Refuge, OCS=Outer Continental Shelf Area, OTHE=Other Easement, PAGR=Private Agricultural, PCON=Private Conservation, PFOR=Private Forest Stewardship, PHCA=Private Historic or Cultural, POTH=Private Other or Unknown, PPRK=Private Park, PRAN=Private Ranch, PREC=Private Recreation or Education, PROC=Approved or Proclamation Boundary, PUB=National Public Lands, RANE=Ranch Easement, REA=Research or Educational Area, REC=Recreation Management Area, RECE=Recreation or Education Easement, RMA=Resource Management Area, RNA=Research Natural Area, SCA=State Conservation Area, SDA=Special Designation Area, SHCA=State Historic or Cultural Area, SOTH=State Other or Unknown, SP=State Park, SREC=State Recreation Area, SRMA=State Resource Management Area, SW=State Wilderness, TRIBL=Native American Land Area, UNK=Unknown, UNKE=Unknown Easement, WA=Wilderness Area, WPA=Watershed Protection Area, WSA=Wilderness Study Area, WSR=Wild and Scenic River

table:columns.name: Loc_Ds
table:columns.description: Local designation. Official designation name in original language or local terminology. Examples: 'Parque Nacional', 'Área Natural Protegida'.

table:columns.name: Unit_Nm
table:columns.description: Unit name. Official name of the protected area as designated by the managing authority. Primary identifier for the site.

table:columns.name: Loc_Nm
table:columns.description: Local name. Alternative, historical, or local name for the protected area when different from Unit_Nm. May be null if no alternative name exists.

table:columns.name: State_Nm
table:columns.description: State name. U.S. state, territory, or freely associated state where the protected area is located. Two-letter postal abbreviations (e.g., 'CA', 'PR', 'GU'). Values: AK=Alaska, AL=Alabama, AR=Arkansas, AS=American Samoa, AZ=Arizona, CA=California, CO=Colorado, CT=Connecticut, DC=District of Columbia, DE=Delaware, FL=Florida, GA=Georgia, GU=Guam, HI=Hawaii, IA=Iowa, ID=Idaho, IL=Illinois, IN=Indiana, KS=Kansas, KY=Kentucky, LA=Louisiana, MA=Massachusetts, MD=Maryland, ME=Maine, MI=Michigan, MN=Minnesota, MO=Missouri, MP=Northern Mariana Islands, MS=Mississippi, MT=Montana, NC=North Carolina, ND=North Dakota, NE=Nebraska, NH=New Hampshire, NJ=New Jersey, NM=New Mexico, NV=Nevada, NY=New York, OH=Ohio, OK=Oklahoma, OR=Oregon, PA=Pennsylvania, PR=Puerto Rico, RI=Rhode Island, SC=South Carolina, SD=South Dakota, TN=Tennessee, TX=Texas, UM=U.S. Minor Outlying Islands, UNKF=Unknown (state/territory not determined), UT=Utah, VA=Virginia, VI=U.S. Virgin Islands, VT=Vermont, WA=Washington, WI=Wisconsin, WV=West Virginia, WY=Wyoming

table:columns.name: Agg_Src
table:columns.description: Aggregator source. Organization that compiled or aggregated the data, often state agencies or regional coordination entities that collected source data into PAD-US.

table:columns.name: GIS_Src
table:columns.description: GIS source. Original GIS data provider or source dataset name. Indicates where the spatial data came from (e.g., agency name, dataset title).

table:columns.name: Src_Date
table:columns.description: Source date. Date of the source GIS data in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format. Indicates when the source spatial data was created or last updated by the providing agency.

table:columns.name: GIS_Acres
table:columns.description: GIS-calculated area in acres of the source polygon. Most reliable area measure, calculated from the geometry.

table:columns.name: Source_PAID
table:columns.description: Source Protected Area ID. Unique identifier from the source agency's dataset. Used to track provenance and updates from source systems.

table:columns.name: WDPA_Cd
table:columns.description: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) site code. Assigned to sites that are internationally recognized and included in the WDPA. Null for sites not in WDPA.

table:columns.name: Pub_Access
table:columns.description: Public access code. Values: OA=Open Access, RA=Restricted Access, UK=Unknown, XA=Closed Access

table:columns.name: Access_Src
table:columns.description: Access source. Source of the public access information (e.g., agency website, management plan, direct contact with manager).

table:columns.name: Access_Dt
table:columns.description: Access date. Date the public access status was determined or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: GAP_Sts
table:columns.description: GAP Status Code indicating level of biodiversity management protection. Values: 1=Permanent protection, biodiversity the primary management goal; natural disturbance proceeds or is mimicked, 2=Permanent protection, biodiversity the primary management goal; natural disturbance suppressed, 3=Permanent protection, managed for multiple uses subject to extractive (e.g. mining, logging) or OHV use, 4=No known mandate for biodiversity protection

table:columns.name: GAPCdSrc
table:columns.description: GAP Code source. Source document or authority used to assign the GAP Status Code (e.g., enabling legislation, management plan, agency policy).

table:columns.name: GAPCdDt
table:columns.description: GAP Code date. Date the GAP Status Code was assigned or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: IUCN_Cat
table:columns.description: IUCN Protected Area Management Category. Values: II=National Park, III=Natural Monument or Feature, IV=Habitat/Species Management Area, Ia=Strict Nature Reserve, Ib=Wilderness Area, Other Conservation Area=Other conservation area (does not meet IUCN protected-area definition), Unassigned=Not assigned an IUCN management category, V=Protected Landscape/Seascape, VI=Protected area with sustainable use of natural resources

table:columns.name: IUCNCtSrc
table:columns.description: IUCN Category source. Source document or authority used to assign the IUCN Category (e.g., management objectives, legislation).

table:columns.name: IUCNCtDt
table:columns.description: IUCN Category date. Date the IUCN Category was assigned or verified in YYYYMMDD or YYYY format.

table:columns.name: Date_Est
table:columns.description: Date established. When the protected area protection was formally established (legislation signed, easement recorded, etc.). Format varies: YYYYMMDD, YYYY, or text description for historical areas.

table:columns.name: Comments
table:columns.description: Comments. Additional information, caveats, special notes, or clarifications about the protected area feature. May include data quality notes, boundary uncertainties, or historical context.

table:columns.name: Term
table:columns.description: Term flag. Indicates temporary protection: 1 = temporary or term-limited protection; 0 or NULL = permanent protection. Used to identify conservation easements or agreements with expiration dates.

table:columns.name: Duration
table:columns.description: Duration. Description of protection duration for term-limited protections (e.g., '20 years', 'until 2050', 'renewable 10-year terms'). Null for permanent protections.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Shape length. Perimeter length in meters calculated in the original coordinate reference system (USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic). For reference only - recalculate in appropriate CRS for analysis.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Shape area. Area in square meters calculated in the original coordinate reference system (USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic). For reference only - use GIS_Acres for area comparisons.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box. Minimum bounding rectangle of the geometry with coordinates in EPSG:4326. Useful for spatial indexing and quick extent checks without processing full geometry.

table:columns.description: H3 cell ID at resolution 8 (~0.737 km² ≈ 182 acres).

table:columns.description: H3 cell ID at resolution 0, used as the partition key for hive-partitioned reads.

nlcd-hex.title: Annual NLCD land cover — H3 hex (mode), all years
nlcd-hex.description: Dominant-class (mode reducer) H3 hex of Annual NLCD land cover, ALL 20 years in one hive-partitioned dataset keyed by `year` and `h0`. One row per (year, cell). Filter a single year with `WHERE year=YYYY`. **Cross-year land-cover CHANGE is a self-join on the H3 cell across two years** (e.g. `... year=A a JOIN ... year=B b USING(h10) WHERE a.nlcd<>b.nlcd`); no separate change table is needed. The grid is identical across years (same source COG grid), so diffs are exact. Columns are safe to GROUP BY / COUNT; there is no per-feature magnitude column to guard against SUM-ing.

nlcd-hex-fractions.title: Annual NLCD land cover — H3 hex per-class fractional coverage, all years
nlcd-hex-fractions.description: Per-class fractional-coverage H3 hex of Annual NLCD, ALL 20 years, hive-partitioned by `year` and `h0`. **Long format: one row per (year, cell, class)** with `frac` = the class's fractional coverage of the cell (0-1); SUM(frac) over classes within a cell ~= 1. Answers 'what share of an area was class X in year A vs B' directly (filter WHERE year=YYYY; compare across years by cell). Per-class ground area = `frac` * H3 cell area (see the catalog h3-guide; do not use a nominal per-resolution constant).
